structured_output.title: New certificate timestamp metrics may appear in scraped Prometheus data
structured_output.content: The environment sets prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled and prometheus.servicemonitor.targetPort, and it uses cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate, so cert-manager metrics are likely scraped. After upgrade, the new metrics certmanager_certificate_not_before_timestamp_seconds and certmanager_certificate_not_after_timestamp_seconds would be exposed per the release notes. This is an additive feature, so nothing should break, but the extra series could add metric cardinality. Inspect your Prometheus scrape config and any relabel or metric-limit rules, and decide whether to use the new metrics in dashboards or alerts.
